subject: Replanning: two-part demo requested to include Security & Procurement
messages:
From: Aileen Porter <aileen@novushealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <security@novushealth.com>, Novus Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo — need security + procurement included (and possible travel)

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for setting the demo for next week. Quick update from our side: several people we need in the room (security lead Marcus Lee and a procurement rep) are just returning from an off-site and will be traveling on the originally proposed date.

Because of that, we can't make the full panel work on the current slot. Security and procurement have specific questions about data retention, key management, and SLA language; they want to sit through a dedicated review rather than a short Q&A at the end.

Would you be open to splitting the meeting into two parts — a 40 minute product walkthrough for the core product team + a 30 minute security & procurement deep-dive with your security/ops partner? If so, we need to shift to a date after May 24.

I've attached our SSO/requirements spreadsheet so your team can see the things they'll ask about.

Thanks — happy to work through time options.

Best,
Aileen Porter
Director, IT Strategy
Novus Health

Attachment: Novus_SSO_requirements.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Aileen Porter <aileen@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — need security + procurement included (and possible travel)

Hi Aileen — thanks for the heads up and for sending the requirements doc.

Totally understand — we can do a two-part approach and it's actually what we recommend for larger governance panels:
- Session A (40m): product walkthrough for product owners + engineering (high-level architecture, routing, latency/cost controls)
- Session B (30m): security & procurement deep dive (data flow, KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, SLA language)

Proposed next steps:
1) I can create two calendar invites that are linked, or a single series with separate agenda items — whatever is easiest for your schedulers.
2) Can you confirm the list of required attendees for Session B? You mentioned Marcus and procurement; any legal or compliance folks we should loop in?
3) Availability we can offer (all PT): May 25 AM (9:00 or 11:00), May 27 AM (9:30), or May 31 / Jun 1 in the afternoon. If those don't work, propose a couple of windows and we'll prioritize.

I've attached a short security one-pager that outlines what we'll cover in the deep-dive so Marcus and procurement can scan ahead. Vivek (cc) will lead the security conversation.

Looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: redwood-security-onepager.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

From: Aileen Porter <aileen@novushealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <security@novushealth.com>, Novus Procurement <procurement@novushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — need security + procurement included (and possible travel)

Rafael —

Thanks, that breakdown sounds right. Confirming: Session B needs Marcus Lee (security), Carla Nguyen (procurement lead, carla.nguyen@novushealth.com), and one of our GRC analysts (Tariq Hassan). They are all out until May 25 and will need a slot the week of May 31.

We'd prefer separate invites (Session A and Session B) so the product folks can skip the procurement-specific discussion. Also, avoid May 26 — several people are traveling that day.

Can you send proposed slots for the week of May 31? Late morning or early afternoon PT is best for most of the team.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Aileen

P.S. Marcus added a couple of items to the SSO spreadsheet (see updated tab).

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Aileen Porter <aileen@novushealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — need security + procurement included (and possible travel)

Hi Aileen — Vivek here (security/ops). Happy to run Session B.

Availability (PT) for the week of May 31:
- Tue Jun 1, 09:30–10:00 or 11:00–11:30
- Wed Jun 2, 10:00–10:30
- Thu Jun 3, 13:00–13:30

If those work, Rafael / Marissa — can you draft two invites (Session A: 40m product; Session B: 30m security/procurement) and include the updated agendas? I also uploaded a short checklist for the team to reference before the deep-dive.

Link to my scheduling page: https://cal.com/redwood/vivek-security-slot

Thanks — see you all soon.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product Security | Redwood Inference

Attachment: security-checklist.pdf (pdf, 6KB)
